target: Paisaje funcional del Embarcadero del Último Claro en la Ribera Sombría.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Último punto de la ruta donde pequeñas embarcaciones pueden atracar con facilidad antes de que Nhal cierre la ribera.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide landscape at Embarcadero del Último Claro. A small practical landing of weathered timber reaches calm shallow water at the last genuinely open patch of shoreline. Behind the landing, the first dense roots and dark canopy of Nhal close around the continuation of the route; toward Lethra the water and sky remain more open. Keep the landing minimal and utilitarian, suitable only for small boats. The visual story is the final open light before entering forest shade.
negative_constraints: No large port, harbor buildings, lighthouse or settlement
No grand pier or many boats
No magical fog, glowing water or lantern spectacle
No ornate carvings or readable signs
No characters or creatures as focal subject
canon_sources: vintage-telnet/REGIONAL_CONNECTIONS.md — Ribera Sombría / Embarcadero del Último Claro
notes: Hito geográfico canónico; no añadir historia no definida.
